note: Reconstruction: boundaries between parcels are estimated. Method: the 43 traced outlines (Stewart plan c.1824 and 1841 tithe plots, as in parcels.json) were merged and closed by 12 m to make the estate outline; where outlines overlap, an outline lying at least 40% inside a larger one keeps the shared ground (nested subdivision), otherwise the overlap is split along the midline; gaps inside the outline go to the nearest traced parcel (equal-distance line); scraps under 400 m2 were merged into their neighbour; shapes simplified 1.5 m with shared edges kept. Field lines on the OS c.1900 map were not traced into this estimate.
